show.description: A mysterious billionaire returns to India in disguise to reunite with his first love—only to be humiliated and rejected for his apparent poverty. As fate pushes him into a powerful alliance with a fearless CEO, hidden identities unravel and a brutal game of power, pride, and revenge begins. When the truth explodes, the man everyone mocked turns out to be the one who controls everything.
